mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ON-KILL PROPAGATION: GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (on-kill) is the exact T4 door. The kit is dual-element: cold (Herald of Ice shatter) + lightning (Inpulsa explosion). Ailments: freeze (Shield Charge crit-freeze, native shatter payoff) + shock->sunder (Inpulsa requires SHOCKED enemies; PoE shock = engine sunder, false-friend). CHAIN-DEPTH VIOLATION: the source is a CASCADING kill-chain — kill -> explode -> that explosion kills -> which explodes -> ... unbounded hops across the pack. Engine MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 is LOCKED; the map expresses ONE on-kill -> burst-damage step (trigger_chain_shape=apply-consume-pair at depth 1).
